Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our top best sellers are the 222x2x11 (3-Drawer, 2-Tier Pull-Out Spice Rack) and the 33x1x11 (2-Drawer, 1-Tier Pull-Out Spice Rack). Both fit standard cabinet depths (10.6") and feature full-extension drawers with flexible side bands.
The 222x2x11 is ideal if you have standard or half-size spice jars and want to maximize vertical space, holding up to 30 full-size or 60 half-size jars. The 33x1x11 is a single-tier design that gives you extra height clearance, making it better for larger or wider bottles and containers.
